clues.it: Irene era nella 4ª colonna e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Irene was in the 4th column and on the Deck.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 10ª colonna ed esattamente una riga a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 10th column and exactly one row north of Dario.

clues.it: Dario era nella 1ª colonna e accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Dario was in the 1st column and beside a chair.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a una corda e a ovest di Rosa.
clues.en: Carla was beside a rope coil and west of Rosa.

clues.it: Elena era a nord di Giada e in Cabina.
clues.en: Elena was north of Giada and in the Cabin.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 7ª riga e a ovest di Carla.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 7th row and west of Carla.

clues.it: Anna era in una stanza diversa da Elena e in Plancia.
clues.en: Anna was in a different room from Elena and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Giada era accanto a una sedia e da sola in Stiva.
clues.en: Giada was beside a chair and alone in the Hold.

clues.it: Tea era su una rete, accanto a una sedia e in Plancia.
clues.en: Tea was on a net, beside a chair and on the Bridge.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 4th.

steps.it: Solo Bruno può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 3ª è sua.
steps.en: Bruno is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 3rd is theirs.
